All storage local — no accounts, no servers

readstack.title: ReadStack
readstack.description: Save the current page with its readable text into a private stack — search, archive, 200-item cap, JSON export.
readstack.overview: ReadStack stacks what you read: save the current page (title, URL and its readable text) into a personal stack in chrome.storage, with read/unread tracking, search, archive and JSON export. Page text is read only when you click the popup.
highlights: Saves title, URL and readable text to chrome.storage.local
All/Unread/Archived filters with live search
200-item cap with auto-pruning of oldest read items
JSON export of the whole stack

clipnotes.title: ClipNotes
clipnotes.description: Clip a note to anything: save the current page with a personal note, stored privately with search and JSON/Markdown export.
clipnotes.overview: ClipNotes clips a note to anything: save the current page (title, URL, readable text) and add your own note, all stored privately in chrome.storage, with search and JSON/Markdown export.
highlights: Saves page title, URL and readable text plus your own note
Search across all clipped notes
JSON and Markdown export
No host permissions — page content read only on click

assistai.title: AssistAI
assistai.description: Tiny local page assistant: deterministic offline NLU — summary, keywords, entities, conversation history.
assistai.overview: assistai is a tiny local page assistant (MV3): deterministic, offline NLU over the page you are reading — summary by word density, keywords with counts, entities via regex — plus persistent conversation history.
highlights: Summary by word density over the page DOM
Keywords with counts and entities via regex
Persistent conversation history in extension storage
No network calls, no API keys, no models in the cloud

sessionsaver.title: SessionSaver
sessionsaver.description: Window session manager: save snapshots of open tabs and groups, search, restore, auto-save on interval.
sessionsaver.overview: SessionSaver is a window session manager: save a snapshot of your open tabs and groups, search them, restore them later, and auto-save on a configurable interval. Everything stays in local extension storage.
highlights: Snapshots window tabs and tab groups
Search across saved sessions by title or URL
Auto-save on configurable interval
Restore one window or all at once

tabnest.title: TabNest
tabnest.description: Hive the window, keep the pages: close every tab into a named nest with estimated memory savings, restore anytime.
tabnest.overview: TabNest hives the window, keeping the pages: close every tab of a window into a named nest (with an estimated memory saving), then restore one nest or all of them whenever you want. Includes 6-language i18n.
highlights: Named nests with estimated memory savings
Restore one nest or all nests anytime
6-language i18n (EN, ES, FR, PT, IT, DE)
Local storage only

tabsnooze.title: TabSnooze
tabsnooze.description: Background tabs automatically discarded after a configurable idle time — Chrome frees memory, with per-domain exceptions.
tabsnooze.overview: TabSnooze lets the window nap: background tabs are automatically discarded after a configurable idle time (Chrome frees their memory), with per-domain exceptions. Click a sleeping tab to wake it instantly.
highlights: Auto-discards idle background tabs via Chrome native discard
Per-domain whitelist (pinned and active tab exempt)
Configurable idle timeout (1–60 min, default 10)
Wake sleeping tabs instantly with one click

langbridge.title: LangBridge
langbridge.description: Phrase-to-phrase translator: built-in EN-ES-FR dictionary, word-under-cursor, popup phrases, page translation.
langbridge.overview: LangBridge is a phrase-to-phrase translator: a small built-in EN-ES-FR dictionary (~200 terms) that translates words under your cursor, whole phrases in the popup, and known words on the page itself. Everything runs locally in chrome.storage.local.
highlights: Built-in ~200-term EN-ES-FR dictionary
Word-under-cursor tooltip with copy button
Phrase translation in the popup with EN-ES and EN-FR
Page-wide translation with one-click restore

huelens.title: HueLens
huelens.description: Local color inspector: pick colors from page elements, convert HEX/RGB/HSL, keep history, copy and export your palette.
huelens.overview: HueLens is a local color inspector: pick a color from any element of a page on http://127.0.0.1 (computed-style approximation), convert HEX/RGB/HSL, keep a history, copy to clipboard and export your palette. Everything runs locally.
highlights: Computed-style color sampling from any page element
HEX, RGB and HSL conversions computed locally
50-color history with copy and palette export
6-language i18n (EN, ES, FR, PT, IT, DE)

seopulse.title: SeoPulse
seopulse.description: Local on-page SEO check: title, meta, headings, alt text, broken links, text/HTML ratio, keyword density — traffic light scoring.
seopulse.overview: SeoPulse is a local on-page SEO check for pages served from http://127.0.0.1: title, meta description, heading hierarchy, image alt texts, broken links, text/HTML ratio and keyword density, with a score and a traffic light.
highlights: Title, meta, heading hierarchy and image alt text checks
Broken internal links (first 50) and text/HTML ratio
Keyword density with traffic-light (green/yellow/red) scoring
Export report as JSON or Markdown

stackscope.title: StackScope
stackscope.description: Local tech detector: meta generator, script srcs, inline JS, data-* attributes with confidence scoring and JSON export.
stackscope.overview: StackScope is a local technology detector for pages served from http://127.0.0.1: meta generator, known script srcs and inline markers, plus data-* attributes — with match confidence and JSON export. Everything runs locally on the page DOM.
highlights: Detects meta generator, script srcs, inline JS and data-* attributes
Confidence scoring per detected signature
JSON export to clipboard
6-language i18n (EN, ES, FR, PT, IT, DE)
